model: Market-calibrated forward operating sensitivity; frozen historical capital structure
status: Illustrative sensitivity only — not an independent fair-value estimate or a near-term price target
units: USD millions; shares in millions; margin in percentage points
revenue_period: Calendar 2027 recognized revenue, analyst scenarios inferred from disclosed late-2026 operating anchors; not company FY2027 guidance

sources.title: CoreWeave Q3 2026 results — financial tables and outlook
sources.excerpt: Q3 revenue 3,661M and adjusted EBITDA 2,256M. Nine-month revenue 8,314M; FY revenue guidance 13,000–13,300M; exit annualized revenue 20,000–21,000M.

sources.title: CoreWeave Q3 Form 10-Q — capital structure and financing
sources.excerpt: September 30 debt principal 47,505M, finance leases 649M, cash 4,122M. October 30 cover shares: Class A 465,847,732 and Class B 90,277,992. Notes 10–13 cover debt, ATM and equity instruments.

sources.title: SEC submission index observed November 26
sources.excerpt: Live retrieval still lists November 24 Forms 4 as latest filings, November 12 as latest 10-Q and November 10 as latest 8-K. Observation date of a mutable index; not comprehensive issuer news coverage.

sources.title: November 25 completed-session closing reference, observed November 26
sources.excerpt: Reviewed history and overview pages show $42.57 November 25 close at 16:00 EST. Completed-session calibration reference, not an executable quote.

capital_bridge.label: Principal debt
capital_bridge.basis: Reported September 30 principal. Carrying value 46,873M is a different measure. Both recourse and non-recourse obligations included because modeled earnings are consolidated.

capital_bridge.label: Finance lease liabilities
capital_bridge.basis: Reported September 30: 296M current + 353M noncurrent. Included in scenario debt = 48,154M. Operating leases excluded under rent-expensed EBITDA convention.

capital_bridge.label: Cash used in historical bridge
capital_bridge.basis: Reported September 30 cash and equivalents, excluding 2,282M restricted cash. This is NOT verified surplus cash after future obligations. Future collections, capex, financing and dividends are not reconciled.

capital_bridge.label: Basic economic shares
capital_bridge.basis: October 30 Class A+B+C. Deliberately a dated basic-share sensitivity denominator; NOT verified current or fully diluted shares. No conversion assumed; convertible debt remains in principal.

capital_bridge.label: Net debt and finance leases
capital_bridge.basis: Calculated 47,505 + 649 − 4,122 = 44,032M using September 30 balances; no forecast of year-end or 2027 balances.

capital_bridge.label: Calibration enterprise value
capital_bridge.basis: Calculated November 25 reference price 42.57 × older October 30 basic shares 556.125724M + September 30 net claims 44,032M. Mixed-date research bridge, not a verified current EV.

methodology.why_numeric: The public record can support a transparent reverse-valuation stress test, but cannot establish a fully financed forward fair value. The base case is calibrated to a historical quote to expose assumptions, not presented as independent valuation evidence.
methodology.revenue: Bear: Q4 implied revenue low end (13,000−8,314)=4,686M repeated for four quarters =18,744M. Base: 20,500M assumes the midpoint December 2026 monthly run rate is maintained throughout 2027, with no further growth. Bull: 21,000M maintains the high end. Repeating a quarterly/monthly run rate is an analyst assumption, not recognition of all backlog or ARR as revenue.
methodology.margins: Base uses observed Q3 adjusted EBITDA/revenue =2,256/3,661=61.6225%. Bull rounds to62%, consistent with disclosed rounded Q3 margin. Bear55% is an explicit 6.62 percentage-point operating stress; not a source-reported forecast or statistical downside bound. All use adjusted EBITDA, not GAAP profit or free cash flow.
methodology.multiple: Base multiple = historical bridge EV / (20,500 × observed Q3 margin) = 5.3596407x. It is inferred from the chosen assumptions and dated quote; not a peer-comparable or independently justified fair multiple. Bear 20% compression and Bull 20% expansion are symmetric analyst stress parameters around that anchor, not probabilities or observed trading ranges.
methodology.capital_structure: Debt 48,154M, cash 4,122M, claims 0 and basic shares 556.125724M are frozen across cases solely to isolate operating/multiple sensitivity. Zero additional claims is a simplifying assumption, not verification that none exist. Values cannot become price targets until forward financing, restricted cash, capex, operating obligations, other claims and dilution are reconciled.
methodology.lease_consistency: Operating lease liabilities 18,697M are excluded because operating rent stays in EBITDA expenses; finance leases 649M are included. Do not use vendor enterprise values or EBITDAR multiples without a consistent adjustment.
methodology.circularity: Base output necessarily equals the historical 42.57 calibration quote. It does not prove that quote is fair. Comparing its output with a later live quote does not establish mispricing.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.rationale: Hold implied Q4 low-end revenue flat through 2027, stress margin to 55% and compress the calibrated multiple 20%. This combines operational and risk-premium stress; it is not a lower bound.
scenarios.interpretation: Mechanical conditional sensitivity, not a forecast or independent fair-value target.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.rationale: Maintain the midpoint December run-rate throughout 2027 at the observed Q3 margin. Multiple is solved from the old quote, so the output equals 42.57 by construction; no independent upside claim.
scenarios.interpretation: Mechanical conditional sensitivity, not a forecast or independent fair-value target.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.rationale: Maintain high-end December run-rate through 2027, preserve about 62% margin and expand calibrated multiple 20%. Requires financing/cash execution; no additional 2027 growth is assumed.
scenarios.interpretation: Mechanical conditional sensitivity, not a forecast or independent fair-value target.

decision.new_position: Conditional watch, not an automatic buy on the sensitivity spread. Use the December 1 conference to seek actual cash receipts and financing terms; require a current quote, updated capital bridge and an independently defensible valuation assumption before treating this as an entry signal. No recommended order size or stop without portfolio and execution inputs.
decision.existing_holding: Review the holding against delivery, collections and funding evidence. The severe bear sensitivity shows why revenue-only conviction is inadequate. Reconcile the holding to a chosen portfolio risk budget; do not treat the historical base output as a support level or stop.
decision.upgrade: Specific collected customer funds with restrictions disclosed; executable financing through delivery; FY revenue at least 13B, December exit ARR at least 20B and active power above 1.85 GW; updated share/debt bridge retains common-equity value under conservative assumptions. Meeting guidance alone is not a consensus beat.
decision.downgrade: Material delivery/revenue shortfall, adverse collection timing or restrictions, reduced financing access, or new capital terms that erode common value. A falling quote alone does not establish these facts; an undisclosed receipt is unknown rather than a confirmed miss.

sensitivities.label: Additional net senior claims
sensitivities.basis: Each additional 1B net debt/other claims reduces static residual value by about 1.80 per dated basic share, holding operating EV fixed; financed asset creation can offset this and is not modeled.

sensitivities.label: Full 35M ATM share-count stress
sensitivities.basis: About 6.29% additional shares; fixed-equity per-share multiplier 0.9408. This intentionally excludes financing proceeds and is NOT an economic prediction of ATM issuance. Authorization 35M; no sales/forwards as of September 30; later use unknown.

gaps: Latest retrieved SEC list has no later updated consolidated debt/cash/share denominator; do not infer no issuance from the absence of a filing.
Expected 9B customer deposits/prepayments are not added to cash: receipt, restrictions and deployment remain unverified.
FY2027 revenue, margin and full financing schedule are not company guidance in the reviewed source set.
No current fully diluted denominator. Note 13 excluded 158M instruments from loss-per-share calculations, but simply adding them would mishandle conversion debt, strikes, vesting and capped calls.
Adjusted EBITDA ignores depreciation and hardware replacement economics; the model cannot prove sustainable shareholder cash flow.
Analyst 55% bear margin and ±20% multiple bands are stress choices, not statistically calibrated limits. More severe outcomes are possible.
The calibration quote is the completed November 25 session close, not an executable quote. No consensus surprise, option-implied move, borrow cost or technical entry has been verified.
